title: House of Cards
description: Times Square at night, one coloured point for every pair of pixels, each one placed at its own depth. At rest it is just the photograph. Drag and the camera turns a few degrees while the points loosen, drift apart along their depth and in a slow current, so the picture comes apart into a volume of coloured light and shows it was three-dimensional all along. Let go and it settles back into the exact photograph, near points first and the far street last, like a focus pull.
intent: After Radiohead's House of Cards video (James Frost, 2008, shot with Velodyne lidar and no cameras), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/House_of_Cards_(Radiohead_song), and the point clouds of Luma AI captures as they load, https://lumalabs.ai: the world as a drifting cloud of points that holds together as a street, then comes apart.
sources: Photograph: herb, Times Square. Depth: Depth Anything V2 (small).
